title: this is agentic engineering
description: 5-second vertical video showcasing the AEE cycle applied to video production. Agentic engineering means: deterministic pipeline, GPU-accelerated generation, verifiable receipts, zero cloud.

scenes.description: Gold particles emerge from void, forming the text THIS IS
Gold particles form AGENTIC ENGINEERING in wireframe, orbiting slowly
SHA-256 receipt appears as QR code, particles converge, fade to gold glow
